They booked my ticket home to Manila and helped with my tourist visa renewal. Very affordable, and they explained everything clearly. I trust no one else in Dubai now.
Alhamdulillah, our Umrah trip was perfect. A&H handled flights, accommodation in Makkah, and all the arrangements. We just had to show up. Truly a blessing of a service.
Needed help with my trade license and business setup. The team at A&H knew every step of the DED process. Saved me weeks of confusion.

airTicketing.title: Air Ticketing, Domestic & International
airTicketing.shortCopy: Every airline. Every destination. Best available fare, confirmed fast.
airTicketing.description: Whether you're flying home to see family, heading out on a business trip, or jetting off on a long-awaited holiday, we search across all major airlines to find you the right ticket at the right price. No hidden fees, no confusion. Just your seat, confirmed.
includes: All international airlines, Emirates, Etihad, flydubai, Air Arabia, Qatar Airways, Turkish Airlines, and more
Domestic routes across South Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Gulf
Group bookings for families, teams, and corporate travel
Full e-ticket sent via WhatsApp instantly
airTicketing.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help booking an air ticket.

visitWorkVisa.title: UAE Visit Visa & Work Visa
visitWorkVisa.shortCopy: Bringing family to Dubai? Hiring staff? We handle the full visa process, correctly and on time.
visitWorkVisa.description: Getting a UAE visa right the first time matters. Whether you're inviting a family member on a visit, applying for a work permit, or sponsoring someone to join your household, our team knows the exact documentation required and the fastest processing path.
visitWorkVisa.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help with a UAE visit or work visa.

hotelBooking.title: Hotel Booking, Budget to 5-Star Luxury
hotelBooking.shortCopy: The right room changes everything. We book hotels worldwide, at every budget, for every trip.
hotelBooking.description: A good hotel is more than a place to sleep, it's where your trip really begins. We work with hundreds of hotels across the UAE and globally to find you the best-value option that matches your style, budget, and itinerary.
includes: UAE hotels (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah)
International hotels across Asia, Europe, Africa, and beyond
Group hotel bookings for families and corporate delegations
hotelBooking.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help booking a hotel.

holidayPackages.title: Holiday Packages, Curated for Every Traveller
holidayPackages.shortCopy: Handcrafted holidays to the world's most exciting destinations. All-inclusive, stress-free, unforgettable.
holidayPackages.description: A proper holiday shouldn't require weeks of planning. We put together complete travel packages, flights, hotels, transfers, and selected tours, for the most popular destinations from Dubai.
holidayPackages.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in a holiday package.

thailand.title: Thailand
thailand.copy: Bangkok's chaos, Chiang Mai's temples, Phuket's beaches, Thailand offers something for every kind of traveller. Our Thailand packages start from Dubai with return flights, central hotel accommodation, and airport transfers included.
thailand.highlights: Grand Palace Bangkok | Phi Phi Islands | Floating Markets | Muay Thai Experience
thailand.from: From AED 1,499 per person | 5 nights / 6 days
thailand.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in a Thailand holiday package.

malaysia.title: Malaysia
malaysia.copy: Kuala Lumpur's skyline, Langkawi's white sand beaches, Penang's legendary street food, Malaysia is one of Southeast Asia's most rewarding escapes.
malaysia.highlights: Petronas Twin Towers | Batu Caves | Langkawi Island | Penang Heritage Trail
malaysia.from: From AED 1,299 per person | 5 nights / 6 days
malaysia.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in a Malaysia holiday package.

singapore.title: Singapore
singapore.copy: A city that blends futuristic architecture, lush gardens, and some of the finest food in Asia. Perfect for families, couples, and solo travellers alike.
singapore.highlights: Marina Bay Sands | Gardens by the Bay | Universal Studios | Hawker Centre Experience
singapore.from: From AED 1,799 per person | 4 nights / 5 days
singapore.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in a Singapore holiday package.

azerbaijan.title: Azerbaijan (Baku)
azerbaijan.copy: Where ancient fire temples meet ultramodern architecture, Baku is unlike anywhere else on earth. Walk the medieval Old City in the morning and stand before the Flame Towers at night.
azerbaijan.highlights: Flame Towers | Walled Old City (UNESCO) | Gobustan Rock Art | Mud Volcanoes | Fire Temple of Ateshgah
azerbaijan.from: From AED 999 per person | 4 nights / 5 days
azerbaijan.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in an Azerbaijan holiday package.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.copy: From the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An to the electric energy of Ho Chi Minh City and the magical waters of Ha Long Bay, Vietnam rewards every type of traveller.
vietnam.highlights: Ha Long Bay Cruise | Hoi An Ancient Town | Hue Imperial City | Mekong Delta
vietnam.from: From AED 1,399 per person | 6 nights / 7 days
vietnam.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in a Vietnam holiday package.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.copy: A destination still untouched by mass tourism, Myanmar offers Buddhist pagodas at sunrise, ancient kingdoms, and the serene beauty of Inle Lake.
myanmar.highlights: Shwedagon Pagoda | Bagan Temple Sunrise | Inle Lake Boat Tour | Mandalay Hill
myanmar.from: From AED 1,599 per person | 6 nights / 7 days
myanmar.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in a Myanmar holiday package.

europe.title: Europe Tour Packages
europe.copy: Paris, Rome, Istanbul, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Europe is the bucket list that never gets old. We arrange Schengen tourist visa applications alongside your full package.
europe.highlights: Eiffel Tower Paris | Colosseum Rome | Istanbul Bosphorus | Sagrada Família Barcelona

europe.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in a Europe tour package.

cruiseTours.shortCopy: Luxury on the open water. We arrange cruise packages from Dubai and international ports worldwide.
cruiseTours.description: A cruise is unlike any other holiday, waking up in a new city every day, with your hotel floating beneath your feet. We book cruise packages across the Arabian Gulf, Mediterranean, Southeast Asia, and beyond.
includes: Mediterranean Cruise: Rome, Barcelona, Dubrovnik, Santorini (7–14 nights)
Southeast Asia Cruise: Singapore, Penang, Langkawi, Phuket (7–10 nights)
Cruise ticket booking (all major cruise lines)
Pre/post cruise hotel accommodation and transfers

cruiseTours.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in a cruise package.

umrahPackages.title: Umrah Packages, By Air & By Bus
umrahPackages.shortCopy: A sacred journey handled with the care it deserves. Air and bus packages available for all budgets.
umrahPackages.description: Performing Umrah is one of the most significant journeys a Muslim can make. At A&H, we treat every Umrah booking with the reverence it deserves, ensuring your travel, accommodation, and logistics are arranged so you can focus entirely on your worship.
includes: Return flights Dubai ↔ Jeddah or Medina
Bus packages with comfortable coach travel

umrahPackages.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'm interested in an Umrah package.

desertSafari.title: Desert Safari Dubai, The Real Arabian Experience
desertSafari.shortCopy: Dune bashing, camel riding, henna, BBQ, and a sky full of stars. The Dubai experience you'll never forget.
desertSafari.description: No visit to Dubai is complete without heading into the desert. Our Desert Safari packages take you into the vast, golden dunes with thrilling dune bashing in 4x4 Land Cruisers, camel rides, sandboarding, henna, and a spectacular BBQ dinner under an open sky.
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Dubai
Traditional Arabic costume photoshoot and henna
Live belly dancing and Tanoura show
desertSafari.price: Evening Safari from AED 150 per person | Morning Safari from AED 120 per person
desertSafari.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to book a desert safari in Dubai.

horseRiding.title: Horse Riding Dubai
horseRiding.shortCopy: Ride through desert trails or beach shorelines. A unique Dubai experience for all skill levels.
horseRiding.description: Dubai's equestrian culture runs deep, and riding through the desert or along the coastline is one of the city's most memorable experiences. We arrange sessions at licensed Dubai stables, suitable for first-timers and experienced riders alike.
includes: Transfer to and from your Dubai hotel
Desert trail or beach ride options
horseRiding.price: From AED 200 per person (30 min session)
horseRiding.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'd like to book a horse riding experience in Dubai.

travelInsurance.shortCopy: Travel confidently. We arrange comprehensive travel insurance for every trip.
travelInsurance.description: We arrange travel insurance for all A&H tour packages and as a standalone service. Coverage includes medical emergencies, trip cancellations, lost baggage, and flight delays.
travelInsurance.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need travel insurance for my trip.

airportPickup.title: Airport Transfers Dubai
airportPickup.shortCopy: Land in Dubai and be met with your name on a board. Clean cars, punctual drivers, fixed prices.

Saloon, SUV, and van options (1 to 14 passengers)
airportPickup.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need an airport transfer in Dubai.

hero.title: UAE Bureaucracy. Handled.
hero.subtitle: From employment visas to trade licenses, Emirates ID to document typing, our PRO team takes care of every administrative requirement so you can focus on living and working in Dubai.

employmentVisa.title: Employment Visa UAE, 2 Years
employmentVisa.shortCopy: Work legally in Dubai. We process 2-year employment visas for all nationalities, end to end.
employmentVisa.description: Getting your employment visa right is the foundation of your life in the UAE. Our team handles every step, from entry permit to medical to Emirates ID, with speed, accuracy, and full transparency on costs.
includes: Work permit application (Ministry of Human Resources)
Entry permit stamping and status change
Labour contract attestation and visa stamping
employmentVisa.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help with a 2-year employment visa in UAE.

familyVisa.title: Family Residence Visa, UAE
familyVisa.shortCopy: Bring your family to Dubai. We process 2-year family residence visas for spouse, children, and parents.
familyVisa.description: Your family belongs with you. We manage the full sponsorship application, ensuring the correct salary threshold, documentation, and medical procedures are all handled correctly.
includes: Emirates ID for sponsored family member
familyVisa.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to bring my family to Dubai on a family visa.

touristVisa.title: UAE Tourist Visa, 30 & 60 Days
touristVisa.shortCopy: Visit Dubai with a clean, correctly processed tourist visa. Single and multiple entry available.
touristVisa.description: We process UAE tourist visas for all nationalities, with both 30-day and 60-day options. All documents are submitted correctly the first time, avoiding costly delays of a rejection.
touristVisa.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need a UAE tourist visa.

schengenVisa.title: Schengen Visa & Europe Tourist Visa
schengenVisa.shortCopy: Dreaming of Europe? We handle your Schengen visa application with full document preparation support.
schengenVisa.description: The Schengen visa unlocks 27 European countries with a single application. With our support, you'll submit a complete, well-prepared application that gives you the strongest possible chance of approval.
includes: Document checklist tailored to your nationality
Travel itinerary and hotel booking confirmation
schengenVisa.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help with a Schengen visa application.

tasheel.title: Tas-Heel Services
tasheel.shortCopy: Ministry of Human Resources services, processed correctly and on time.
tasheel.description: Tas-Heel is the UAE MOHRE service centre, the official channel for employment-related government services. Our team handles all Tas-Heel requirements for employers and employees.
tasheel.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help with Tas-Heel services.

amer.title: Amer Services, ICA & GDRFA
amer.shortCopy: Immigration authority services handled smoothly. Status changes, entry bans, and more.
amer.description: Amer Centres are the official service channel for ICA and GDRFA. We process all Amer-related requirements for individuals, families, and businesses.
includes: Visa cancellation and GCC resident visa processing
amer.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help with Amer services.

emiratesId.title: Emirates ID & Medical Fitness
emiratesId.shortCopy: Emirates ID registration, renewals, and medical fitness tests, coordinated and completed.
emiratesId.description: Every UAE resident must hold a valid Emirates ID. We handle the entire process, including booking your medical fitness test and submitting your application through the correct channels.
includes: New Emirates ID application and renewal
Medical fitness test booking (DHA approved centres)
Emirates ID status tracking and collection
emiratesId.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help with Emirates ID or medical fitness.

ded.title: DED & Economic Services
ded.shortCopy: Trade license applications, renewals, and economic department services, handled by our PRO team.
ded.description: The Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism governs all business licensing activity in Dubai. Our PRO team ensures your business remains compliant.
ded.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help with DED or trade license services.

businessSetup.title: Business Setup in Dubai
businessSetup.shortCopy: Launch your business in Dubai, mainland or free zone. We guide you from registration to operation.
businessSetup.description: We help entrepreneurs, freelancers, and companies establish their presence in Dubai with the right license type, structure, and approvals from day one.
includes: Dubai Mainland and Free Zone setup
Trade name reservation and license application
Bank account opening guidance and visa quota setup
businessSetup.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to set up a business in Dubai.

proServices.title: PRO Services, Full Document Clearance
proServices.shortCopy: Government departments, attestations, and document clearance, handled by our experienced PRO team.
proServices.description: Our PRO team visits the required ministries, courts, and government offices on your behalf, saving you days of queuing and navigating complex processes.
includes: Police clearance certificate and NOC applications
proServices.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need PRO or document clearance services.

documentTyping.title: Document Typing, All Government Forms
documentTyping.shortCopy: Every UAE government form, typed correctly in Arabic and English. No errors. No rejections.
documentTyping.description: A single typing error on a UAE government form can cause delays, fines, or outright rejection. Our document typing service ensures every form is completed correctly.
includes: Visa application forms and labour contracts
Tenancy contracts (Ejari) and power of attorney
Business letters, NOC letters, and affidavits
MOA / partnership agreements and court documents
documentTyping.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need document typing services.

translation.title: Translation Services, Legal & General
translation.shortCopy: Certified Arabic ↔ English translations and general document translation in multiple languages.
translation.description: Many UAE processes require officially translated documents. We provide certified legal translations accepted by UAE courts and government, plus general translations for personal documents.
includes: Arabic ↔ English | Urdu | Hindi | Tagalog | Bengali | Malayalam
Certified translations accepted by UAE authorities
translation.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need a document translation.

ejari.title: Ejari Registration & Renewal
ejari.shortCopy: Ejari tenancy contract registration, required for residency visas, Emirates ID, and utilities setup.
ejari.description: Ejari is mandatory for anyone renting in Dubai. Without it, you cannot process your residence visa, Emirates ID, or connect DEWA utilities. We register your Ejari quickly and correctly.
includes: Ejari cancellation on vacating a property
ejari.price: From AED 220 | Same day in most cases
ejari.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help with Ejari registration.

medicalInsurance.title: Medical & Stamping Insurance
medicalInsurance.shortCopy: UAE visa-required health insurance and stamping insurance, arranged quickly.
medicalInsurance.description: UAE residence visa processing requires valid health insurance. We arrange both basic stamping insurance and comprehensive medical insurance plans for you and your family.
medicalInsurance.whatsappMessage: Hi, I need help with visa or medical insurance in UAE.

hero.title: Built for the People Who Make Dubai Home.
hero.subtitle: A&H Travel and Tourism was founded with one purpose, to make travel and life in the UAE smoother, faster, and more affordable for everyone who calls Dubai home.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To provide reliable, convenient, and customer-focused travel and visa solutions by helping individuals, families, and businesses achieve smooth and stress-free travel experiences through professional service, trusted guidance, and personalized support.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To become a trusted and leading travel and tourism partner in Dubai, recognized for excellence, reliability, and customer satisfaction while connecting people to global opportunities and unforgettable travel experiences.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: We started in International City, one of Dubai's most diverse and vibrant communities, because that's where the need was greatest. Thousands of families, workers, and entrepreneurs navigating a new country, a new system, and a new life.
story.p2: A&H was built to serve those people. Not with complicated processes or hidden costs, but with honest, fast, and professional service in the languages our community speaks.
story.p3: Today, we handle everything from air tickets to employment visas, desert safaris to business setups. Over 2,500 clients have trusted us with their most important journeys and documents. We take that trust seriously.
